//: JSON has no comments, so keys starting with // are inline docs. The verifier ignores them (extra keys are allowed; test.sh reads only the real keys). Leave or delete them freely.
// before_repo_set_cmd: Optional shell run before scoring (e.g. checkout gold tests). Usually blank.
// selected_test_files_to_run: Whole test files for the DEFAULT pytest path. Only used when test_cmd is empty; ignored otherwise.
// fail_to_pass / pass_to_pass: Test IDs that must flip-green (F2P) / stay-green (P2P). Use the EXACT IDs your log_parser emits -- run the parser on a sample of your test output once and copy them. Format is parser-specific: pytest 'tests/t.py::test_x'; junit 'com.pkg.FooTest testBar' (SPACE-joined); cargo 'tests::my_test'; jest = leaf description only; C# 'Ns.Class.Method'.
// test_cmd: Command(s) the verifier runs in the repo. A string, or a list of strings to run in order. Empty -> falls back to pytest over selected_test_files_to_run.
// test_cmd: c (TAP): make check   (or run a binary that prints 'ok N - name' / 'not ok N - name')
// test_cmd: java: maven/gradle write JUnit XML to files, NOT stdout -- run the build then cat the reports so the parser sees them. Use a list: ["mvn test -B -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true", "find . -path '*surefire-reports*' -name 'TEST-*.xml' -exec cat {} +"] with log_parser=parse_log_junit.
// log_parser: Parser matching your runner's output. Common: parse_log_pytest | parse_log_jest | parse_log_vitest | parse_log_gotest | parse_log_cargo | parse_log_junit (java/surefire) | parse_log_csharp | parse_log_googletest | parse_log_bash (TAP). Full list: NAME_TO_PARSER in tests/log_parsers.py.
